slides.scene: Wide family-function courtyard. Anchal stands in the group-photo area with a visibly open place beside her; Zuv is across the courtyard and pauses mid-step, unsure whether the call is soft or urgent. The frame establishes distance and the need to call without showing two versions or splitting the composition.
Earlier, close profile of Anchal calling softly through a doorway. Relaxed shoulders, gentle smile, warm eye-line, one open hand inviting him closer.
Long view through the doorway. Zuv hears her, looks up with an easy smile, finishes one cuff, and walks toward her slowly while replying.

slides.on_image_text: When she says it like THAT...
slides.scene: Later, wide group-photo staging in the courtyard. Anchal is already beside the empty saved place and calls urgently across the courtyard because the family-photo setup is ready. Her torso and open hand indicate the visibly empty place beside her; she is urgent, never angry. Zuv is distant enough to hear but not yet understand why.
slides.shot: wide ensemble with clear empty place

slides.scene: Tight reaction on Zuv near the courtyard edge. He freezes mid-motion with raised brows and makes one minimal pocket or key check, puzzled and amused rather than afraid. His eye-line snaps toward Anchal. No flashbacks, icons, or thought bubble.

Low diagonal action shot. Zuv crosses the open courtyard briskly toward the saved place, forward lean and arm swing proving the new speed. Anchal remains active in the background, keeping the place open beside her.
Low wide group-photo payoff. Zuv arrives slightly breathless into the saved space. Anchal hooks his elbow as their formal pose breaks into shared laughter. Neither apologizes or rescues the other.
